description: Read the findings and recommendations Fudge has saved for this store, most important first; narrow by area, subject, kind, date or text. With `ref`, one record in full with its sources and measurements. An empty list means nothing is saved yet. This never starts an investigation.

area.description: seo, ai-discovery, conversion or merchandising, or a library such as landing-pages or quizzes.

query.description: Words to find in the title, summary or body.

ref.description: Read one record in full; the other filters are ignored.

since.description: Only records created or updated on or after this date.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

subject.description: A product, collection, page or article ID (product-42 or a Shopify GID), or a Fudge Plan ref.

name: get_store_insights
title: Get saved findings
